paragraphs.text:
A blast from the creature’s device strikes Bernard squarely in 
the back. He gives a stifled cry and falls on his face. The flyer 
wheels and turns its attention to Sylvia.

Make a Dodge roll for Sylvia: if she succeeds, go to 640; if she fails, 
go to 641.
